acceptance.claim: The Toppan Download cron accepts files named DPT-URA-RD2-D2-* and DPT-URA-DN2-D2-* and parses notice number plus postal registration number. The file layout is known from code only; there is no interface spec in the repo.
acceptance.missing: Accept list: ToppanDownloadHelper.java:98-99 (used at :71). Parse routing: ToppanResponseParser.java:153 (RD2) and :157 (DN2); notice no = content.substring(10, 20) at :627 (must match 9 digits + letter, :642); registration no = substring(222, 237) at :704 (A15, uppercase alphanumeric, :710). Gap to know: a detail record shorter than 237 chars gives no registration number (:703) but the notice is still counted successful (:525). Schedule: cron-schedules-prod.properties:90-91 (0 30 1 * * ?, enabled=true), real server value cannot be verified from repo.

acceptance.claim: For an RD2 file the number is written to ocms_request_driver_particulars.postal_regn_no; for a DN2 file to ocms_driver_notice.postal_regn_no (update only; the tracking row must already exist, and those rows are created only by the Toppan upload flow). A notice that exists in VON but has no tracking row is logged as a warning and still counted as updated.
acceptance.missing: Proved: table by file name :230-236; UPDATE only joins existing rows (:517-521 DN, :593-597 RDP); warn :271; counted as updated :301 (this line). 'Created only by the Toppan upload flow': the only creator found by grep is ToppanUploadHelper.java:889-897; absence in other code or DB tools cannot be proved. Extra edge: if several tracking rows exist for the same notice and stage, only one (the last returned by the query, no ORDER BY) is updated (:362-367).
acceptance.fix_en: For an RD2 file the number is written to ocms_request_driver_particulars.postal_regn_no; for a DN2 file to ocms_driver_notice.postal_regn_no. It is an update only: the tracking row (notice_no + stage) must already exist; the only code found that creates these rows is the Toppan upload flow (ToppanUploadHelper). A notice that exists in VON but has no tracking row is logged as a warning and still counted as updated; if several rows exist for the same notice and stage only one of them is updated.
